description: EU Deforestation Regulation (EUDR, Reg. (EU) 2023/1115) scope and country-risk check: for up to 25 HS/CN codes with country of production, is the product in Annex I (cattle, cocoa, coffee, oil palm, rubber, soya, wood), which commodity, the country's risk level under Implementing Reg. (EU) 2025/1093, the due-diligence regime and when obligations apply for your role and company size. Also lists Annex I products or country risk levels. Provided by Atlas Data (third-party seller); cached up to 24 h. © European Union, Decision 2011/833/EU. Not legal advice; not legally binding. Price 0.02 USD per call via x402.

codes.description: mode=check: up to 25 lines 'HS/CN code|country of production' separated by ',' or ';', e.g. 1801 00 00|CI,4407 11|SE (country optional if 'country' is set)

companySize.description: Sets the application date (30 Dec 2026, or 30 Jun 2027 for micro/small); default unknown

country.description: Default country for lines without one (check), or a country filter (listCountries); ISO alpha-2/alpha-3 or English name

includeAnnexDetails.description: Add the Annex I description and exclusions to each line (default true)

maxItems.description: Max rows (check: default all lines; lists: default 10; clamped to 25)

mode.description: check (default) = classify your lines; listProducts = Annex I table; listCountries = 2025/1093 country risk levels

offset.description: List modes: skip this many rows

referenceDate.description: Evaluate scope and application dates on this date (default today, UTC)

role.description: Which obligations are summarised (Art. 4 vs Art. 5); default operator

name: eudr_check
